In the frontline, Pedro has already scored three times and produced three assists in the top flight, while Palmer has two goals and two assists in the Premier League so far.

Palmer , left ‌out of England 's World Cup squad ‌this year after a persistent groin injury ‌affected his form, was called up ‌by Thomas Tuchel for Nations League fixtures against Spain, the Czech Republic and Croatia.

reasons.text: After initially appearing on the injury report as limited , Palmer missed Saturday's practice and was ruled out for the game "He got kind of twisted up yesterday in practice.
He scored early against Bournemouth and also rose in price this week, making him a sensible option for managers who cannot stretch to Palmer but still want a route into Chelsea’s front line.
There were doubts about the involvement of Caicedo and Pedro against Bournemouth, while Palmer missed international duty with England due to injury.

Konsa started two of England's first three matches in the current international break, playing the full 90 in the 3-2 loss to Spain and 7-0 thumping of Croatia, either side of being an unused substitute in the 2-0 win over Czechia.
KONSA RETURNS TO ARSENAL It’s been a rollercoaster international break for Ezri Konsa (£4.6m) and his owners in Fantasy Premier League (FPL).
Konsa was sidelined ( as a non-playing substitute ) for last Tuesday’s win over Czechia with a muscular niggle.
Konsa was brought to the Emirates Stadium to provide defensive reinforcement following a long-term back injury to star centre-back William Saliba.
Konsa sat out the midweek win over the Czech Republic as an unused substitute due to a minor injury issue.

Arsenal and England fans will be pleased to hear that Konsa is already back in training and should be ready for the fixture in Rijeka. © Iconsport / PA Images England receive Konsa fitness boost Speaking at Friday's press conference, Tuchel said: "It seems that Ezri Konsa is back.

Martinez was stretchered off in the 75th minute with a head injury following a clash with Jarrad Branthwaite , and though Everton tried to apply late pressure to substitute Mike Penders , they were instead almost caught out at the other end as Pickford had to make himself big to deny João Pedro following a Palmer-led counter-attack.
ST: JoÃ£o Pedro — 6.8: A quiet afternoon for the Brazilian striker, who was often left isolated up front and struggled to get involved in the game.
